page.layout: Running head centred at top; page number 192 top left. One main text column of justified running text; a section heading XLIII. inline within the text. Left margin holds a block of small marginal notes (Coaxatus, coccyfmus, perpetuus, quo Reges, Principes mundi, ad bellum, sacrum indicendum) placed beside the text. Catchword-like word "rofis" at lower right of the text block, and a stamp at the bottom right (digitiser credit) which is omitted.
